children: Our Bureau Kolkata: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank is looking to raise 409 crore in a preferential equity allotment to International Finance Corporation and three local life insurance companies. IFC is likely to invest 249 crore while the balance will be put in by Bajaj Life Insurance Co, Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance Co and HDFC Life Insurance Co, Ujjivan said in a stock exchange filing.

The bank will privately place up to 6.32 crore equity shares at 64.73, including a premium of 54.73 each over face value of 10, it said. The board approved the execution of the subscription agreement with IFC. Meanwhile, Ujjivan reported a 200% surge in second quarter net profit at 365 crore, riding on a 35% rise in net interest income at 1,244 crore. Its net interest margin was at 8.4%, up 55 basis points year-on-year.

title: Ujjivan SFB to Raise 409 crore From IFC, 3 Life Insurers
